# Kseniya Bortnikova

## Economist

**PhD in Economics · Charles University, Prague (2026)**
:::

::: {.about-text}
I completed my PhD at the Institute of Economic Studies, Charles University, in
November 2026. My dissertation, *Essays on Empirical Research in Labor and
Financial Markets*, was written under the supervision of Professor
[Tomáš Havránek](https://ies.fsv.cuni.cz/en/contacts/people/78067720).

Much of my research uses meta-analysis to examine how empirical findings vary
across studies and how much of a reported effect remains once selective
reporting is taken into account. My work is mainly in labour and financial
economics, with a particular interest in the economics of beauty. I also work on
questions in health economics and applied policy.

My work has appeared in the *Journal of Economic Surveys*, the *Journal of
Economics*, and the *Czech Journal of Economics and Finance*. Two coauthored
papers are currently under review: a meta-analysis of beauty and professional
success, in second-round revision at *Nature Human Behaviour*, and a
meta-analysis of exercise and cognitive performance, under review at the
*British Journal of Sports Medicine*. I am currently looking for postdoctoral
and academic positions.

Alongside my research, I have taught econometrics, game theory, and financial management at Charles University and the Prague University of Economics and Business (VŠE).
:::
